title: The Mapmakers Lament
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Cartographer Jonah Reyes has spent forty years mapping the fictional island of his childhood — a place that never existed, drawn from the lies of a father he barely knew. When a real expedition claims to have found the island, Jonah must decide whether to publish the truth or let the lie become his legacy.
short_description: Jonah's life's work is Isla Perdida, a beloved fictional island from his father's shipwreck story.
long_description: Jonah's life's work is Isla Perdida, a beloved fictional island from his father's shipwreck story. A real expedition claims to have found it — a bare rock. Jonah sails there, publishes a two-faced map (the bare rock and the beloved fiction), and reconciles with his father's ghost.
main_characters: Father Reyes — dead, present in marginalia
Dr. Ana Soler — expedition scientist, skeptical, warm
Isla Perdida — the island as a character
